task.name: Prepare_build_truck
task.when: Before the equipment truck departs for Black Rock City

step.action: Confirm that 📦 Truck_Load_Plan matches the assigned truck and current inventory.
Count each asset group against the load plan before loading.
Load each asset group in the printed order and position.
Secure each load section with the specified restraint.
Record every missing, substituted, or unloaded item on 📦 Truck_Load_Plan.
Have the Build Lead inspect weight distribution, restraint, door clearance, and the final inventory.

passWhen.criterion: The final inventory and every exception are recorded.
Every loaded item is in its planned position and secured.
The Build Lead approved weight distribution and door clearance.
The truck is closed and latched.
